tools.name: whats_in_my_cc.search_sessions
tools.description: List recent Claude Code sessions observed locally.

project.description: Project root path — only sessions with ≥1 event whose cwd equals this path (trailing slash ignored)

tools.name: whats_in_my_cc.get_file_lineage
tools.description: Return the diff-hunk lineage for a specific file in a session.

file_path.description: File path to trace lineage for

tools.name: whats_in_my_cc.get_otel_trace
tools.description: Return OTel spans for a trace ID observed in this session.

tools.name: whats_in_my_cc.get_session_turns
tools.description: Turn-level deterministic rollup of a session: per-user-turn tool histogram, edited files, and cross-turn file churn. Counts and redacted excerpts only — judgments (e.g. rework classification) are the caller's.

tools.name: whats_in_my_cc.get_project_metrics
tools.description: Cross-session deterministic metrics series: per-session behavioral counts (SessionMetrics) plus environment fingerprint (models, cc_versions, git_branches, cwds, entrypoints). Counts and observations only — rates and judgments are the caller's.

project.description: Project root path filter (same semantics as search_sessions.project)

from.description: RFC3339 — only sessions whose first observed event is at or after this time

to.description: RFC3339 — only sessions whose first observed event is at or before this time

limit.description: Max sessions returned (newest first, max 200; matched_count reports pre-truncation total)

tools.name: whats_in_my_cc.list_detectors
tools.description: Return the manifest catalog for all registered detectors (spec §6.4). Each manifest describes what the detector detects, which raw payload fields it reads, by what rule, and why. Use this before proposing config changes or new detectors.
